dialogues.speaker: Chihu Rock Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This is the Chihu Rock Bulletin Board. You can find community news and shop advertisements posted here. Please do not post unimportant matters.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I'm no good at advertisements, so I just decided to post a note on the message board!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Cheap 'n' tasty Zhongyuan Chop Suey! Fragrant, spicy, and guaranteed to satisfy your taste buds!"

dialogues.speaker: Millelith Reply
dialogues.text: "Dear Madam Su, this is a Bulletin Board for announcements, not messages..."

dialogues.speaker: Millelith Reply
dialogues.text: "To publish ads, please register with the Millelith... and please refrain from posting unrelated messages here."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Sorry to trouble you, boys! Come by for a meal when you're off your shift, I'll give you a discount!"
